[Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Gemini, Imagen, BigQuery, Apigee); third-party models Anthropic Claude and Mistral AI]
deployments_detail.value: ~1,600 active users; ~2,500 trained; usage grew from 200 to 3,000 users; 15 use cases

Automatic multilingual translation of presentations and documents to support cross-border operations, via the internal generative-AI platform. [Google Cloud Vertex AI (Gemini)]

Generative-AI assistant for the procurement department to augment buyers: understanding contract clauses, regulatory monitoring, supplier sourcing by criteria, document summarization and supplier relationship support (using Ivalua's IVA assistant). [Ivalua (IVA AI assistant); generative AI]
